crossRefs.note: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.

translations.web: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.
translations.bsb: Does he thank the servant because he did what he was told?
translations.kjv: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.
translations.asv: Doth he thank the servant because he did the things that were commanded?
